name: Stormrage Barrow Dens
summary: Beneath Moonglade, druids sleep in the Stormrage Barrow Dens. Their bodies rest here while their spirits journey through the Emerald Dream.

sections.title: Chambers of the Slumbering
sections.body: Beneath Moonglade, the Stormrage Barrow Dens hold druids in deep sleep. Barrow dens across night elven lands guard their bodies while their spirits journey through the Emerald Dream. These earthen halls bear the name of Archdruid Malfurion Stormrage. Clintar Dreamwalker still sleeps in one of their alcoves. Malfurion is absent, and his brethren keep watch over the quiet chambers.

sections.title: Echoes of the Third War
sections.body: The Stormrage Barrow Dens nearly fell during the Third War. Tichondrius and the Burning Legion sought to destroy the sleeping druids before they could rally. High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind fought demons and corrupted wildlife in the tunnels, then sounded the Horn of Cenarius. The call woke Malfurion Stormrage in time. After Archimonde fell at Mount Hyjal, Malfurion's spirit returned to the Emerald Dream. His brethren still watch over the dens.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Stormrage Barrow Dens?
aliases: what are the barrow dens for
faq.answer: Barrow dens shelter night elf druids while they journey through the Emerald Dream. Their bodies lie still and unguarded for months or years, so their brethren keep watch over these quiet underground sanctuaries.

faq.q: Is Malfurion Stormrage currently inside these dens?
aliases: is malfurion in the barrow dens
faq.answer: Malfurion Stormrage is absent from the dens. He slept there during the Third War, until Tyrande awakened him. Since the war, his spirit has been lost in the Emerald Dream, and the Cenarion Circle carries on without him.

faq.q: Who is currently sleeping within these dens?
faq.answer: Clintar Dreamwalker is among the druids sleeping in the dens. His body rests beneath the earth while his spirit journeys through nature's pathways.

faq.q: What happened to this place during the Third War?
faq.answer: During the Third War, Tichondrius and the Burning Legion invaded the dens to kill the sleeping night elf druids. High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind fought through the demons and sounded the Horn of Cenarius, waking Malfurion.

angles.text: As a druid, you see the Stormrage Barrow Dens as a heart of Cenarion heritage. Elder druids shelter their bodies in the earth while their spirits journey through the Emerald Dream.
As a night elf, you remember the long watch over the sleeping druids and Tyrande Whisperwind's perilous descent to awaken Malfurion against the Burning Legion.
